_about: What platform/run-shim.ts provides. `true` = the whole namespace or function; a list = only those members. tools/check-sdk.mjs compares a game's RundotGameAPI calls against this file. Update it whenever the shim gains something. `decisions` records how F12 Games handles RUN features that can't work the same way here.

decisions.analytics: No tracking on F12 Games (kids platform): every call is a no-op.
decisions.realtime: Rooms are relays on the PHP server; custom room code does not run. See README.
decisions.triggerHapticAsync: Uses the browser vibrate API (Android); does nothing on iPhone and desktop, which have no web vibration.
decisions.iap: No real-money store: the balance is 0, spendCurrency fails with NOT_AVAILABLE and openStore does nothing. A game can offer its own in-game alternative (Stillness sells Crystals for gold, 1 Crystal = 1000 gold).
decisions.ads: No ads: nothing is ever ready and nothing is shown, so no ad rewards.
decisions.shop: Nothing is sold: the catalog is empty, getItemDetail rejects and purchase rejects with direct-purchase-unavailable.
decisions.entitlements: Nobody owns anything: getQuantity is 0, lists are empty, consumeEntitlement rejects.
decisions.simulation: No server-run game logic: isEnabled() is false so games use their on-device fallback; the other calls reject.
decisions.leaderboard: Device-only: each mode keeps this device's best score, and the board shows just that one entry. A game can opt into a shared board on the F12 server with "leaderboard": "shared" in f12.config.json; players then show under a generated nickname (word lists, no free text).
decisions.getProfile: A random device id and the playdate name (default Friend); no real names, no avatar.
decisions.app: getMyRole is always none, so tester and owner tools stay hidden.
decisions.system: Safe area from CSS env(); fullscreen through the browser (unavailable on iPhone Safari, always-on in the installed app); the ads and purchases capabilities are false.
decisions.requestTimeAsync: No time server: serverTime is the device clock, so a player who changes the clock can skip ahead on daily rewards.
